title: Gender and Race Bias in Consumer Product Recommendations by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM for consumer product recommendations using specific gender personas (Woman, Man, Nonbinary) and analyzing linguistic disparities in the generated outputs using Marked Words (log-odds ratios), Support Vector Machines (SVMs), and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD).

Prompting an LLM for consumer product recommendations using specific racial personas (Asian, Black, Latino, Middle-Eastern, White) and analyzing linguistic disparities in the generated outputs using Marked Words (log-odds ratios), Support Vector Machines (SVMs), and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD).
